summary.text: Pete Karas of Muskego, a retired insurance-industry worker and former Racine City Council member who ran as the Wisconsin Green Party's nominee, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Secretary of State of Wisconsin to JoCasta Zamarripa.

paragraphs.text: Pete Karas was born and raised in Racine, where he worked in the insurance industry and owned a small business.
He is a former member of the Racine City Council and has since retired to Muskego.
His campaign lists a Muskego mailing address and argued that, because the office has limited duties, it is a good race in which to elect a third-party candidate.
He received 3.8% of the vote to JoCasta Zamarripa's 50.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
